layer_3_action.subject: Sunny mid-day view of a lacustrine forest
features: Large, calm lake with clear water
Dense forest of conifers and cycads reaching the water's edge
Ground cover of thick, wet moss and sprawling ferns
No grass; only primitive ground-hugging plants
Floating aquatic ferns (Azolla) near the shore
layer_3_action.action: A serene, bright lakeside scene at mid-day. The focus is on the crystal-clear water and the lush, ancient greenery of the forest floor.

visuals.ground: Moist, dark earth covered in a thick, textured carpet of moss and liverworts. Ferns grow in dense clusters near the tree trunks. No grass.
visuals.water: Clear lake water reflecting the bright sun; gentle ripples on the surface.
visuals.sky: Bright blue sky with a brilliant sun at its zenith.

strata_specifics.ground_texture: Saturated organic peat and spongy bryophyte mats.
